records.source: Consecutive-frame training pairs from one Cell Tracking Challenge movie.
records.translation: Paires d’entraînement de trames consécutives d’une séquence Cell Tracking Challenge.

records.context: Frames from ``<movie>/<seq>/t*.tif``, full masks from the silver segmentation ``<movie>/<seq>_ST/SEG/man_seg*.tif`` relabelled by the tracking markers ``<movie>/<seq>_GT/TRA/man_track*.tif`` (:func:`track_masks_from_ctc`). A frame missing any of the three is skipped, and a pair is only formed from two consecutive frame numbers. Slice-mask filenames are ignored and duplicate frame numbers are rejected. A source whose next-frame marker lacks an unambiguous full mask is censored for that pair, rather than labelled as a disappearance.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.ctc_pairs#1
records.source: Frames from ``<movie>/<seq>/t*.tif``, full masks from the silver segmentation ``<movie>/<seq>_ST/SEG/man_seg*.tif`` relabelled by the tracking markers ``<movie>/<seq>_GT/TRA/man_track*.tif`` (:func:`track_masks_from_ctc`). A frame missing any of the three is skipped, and a pair is only formed from two consecutive frame numbers. Slice-mask filenames are ignored and duplicate frame numbers are rejected. A source whose next-frame marker lacks an unambiguous full mask is censored for that pair, rather than labelled as a disappearance.
records.translation: Trames de ``<movie>/<seq>/t*.tif`` et masques complets de la segmentation silver ``<movie>/<seq>_ST/SEG/man_seg*.tif``, réétiquetés selon les marqueurs de suivi ``<movie>/<seq>_GT/TRA/man_track*.tif`` (:func:`track_masks_from_ctc`). Une trame à laquelle manque l'une de ces trois entrées est ignorée ; seules deux trames de numéros consécutifs forment une paire. Les noms de fichiers de masques de coupe sont ignorés et les numéros de trame en double sont refusés. Si le marqueur de la trame suivante d'un objet source ne possède pas de masque complet non ambigu, cet objet est exclu de la supervision de cette paire au lieu d'être étiqueté comme disparu.

records.context: Full object masks labelled with their TRACK ids.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.track_masks_from_ctc#0
records.source: Full object masks labelled with their TRACK ids.
records.translation: Masques complets d'objets portant leurs identifiants TRACK.

records.context: The Cell Tracking Challenge publishes tracking ground truth as MARKERS -- a small blob inside each cell, labelled with its track id in every frame -- and full outlines separately (the silver ``ST/SEG`` masks, labelled per frame). Only one-to-one assignments are retained: the object contains exactly one marker ID and that ID overlaps no other segmented object. Unmarked, merged and split assignments are excluded rather than guessed.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.track_masks_from_ctc#1
records.source: The Cell Tracking Challenge publishes tracking ground truth as MARKERS -- a small blob inside each cell, labelled with its track id in every frame -- and full outlines separately (the silver ``ST/SEG`` masks, labelled per frame). Only one-to-one assignments are retained: the object contains exactly one marker ID and that ID overlaps no other segmented object. Unmarked, merged and split assignments are excluded rather than guessed.
records.translation: Cell Tracking Challenge publie la référence de suivi sous forme de MARKERS : une petite région dans chaque cellule, étiquetée avec son identifiant de trajectoire à chaque trame. Les contours complets sont fournis séparément, sous forme de masques silver ``ST/SEG`` étiquetés par trame. Seules les associations un à un sont conservées : l'objet contient exactement un identifiant de marqueur, et ce marqueur ne recouvre aucun autre objet segmenté. Les associations sans marqueur, fusionnées ou scindées sont exclues plutôt que devinées.

records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.train_timeflows#0
records.source: Train the time head, then the whole network, on track-labelled pairs.
records.translation: Entraîne la tête temporelle, puis tout le réseau, sur des paires étiquetées par trajectoire.

records.context: A two-stage curriculum: the backbone's segmentation is already paid for, so it is frozen while the new head learns, then everything is trained at a low learning rate. Every pair is augmented identically on both frames before its targets are computed.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.train_timeflows#1
records.source: A two-stage curriculum: the backbone's segmentation is already paid for, so it is frozen while the new head learns, then everything is trained at a low learning rate. Every pair is augmented identically on both frames before its targets are computed.
records.translation: Entraînement en deux étapes : la segmentation du réseau de base est déjà apprise ; il reste donc figé pendant l'apprentissage de la nouvelle tête, puis l'ensemble est entraîné à faible taux d'apprentissage. Les deux trames de chaque paire subissent les mêmes augmentations avant le calcul de leurs cibles.

records.context: A training extracted image region keeps supervision only for complete source masks and, when present in the full target frame, complete successor masks. A successor outside the tile is not a disappearance. Absences in the supplied full-frame labels remain supervised; this does not validate those annotations. Unusable extracted image regions are retried up to 32 times per step. Censoring prevents incorrect targets at extracted image region boundaries but removes some fast-motion examples; it does not establish full-motion accuracy.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_model.train_timeflows#2
records.source: A training crop keeps supervision only for complete source masks and, when present in the full target frame, complete successor masks. A successor outside the tile is not a disappearance. Absences in the supplied full-frame labels remain supervised; this does not validate those annotations. Unusable crops are retried up to 32 times per step. Censoring prevents incorrect targets at crop boundaries but removes some fast-motion examples; it does not establish full-motion accuracy.
records.translation: Un recadrage d'entraînement conserve la supervision uniquement pour les masques sources complets et, lorsqu'ils existent dans la trame cible complète, les masques complets des successeurs. Un successeur hors de la tuile n'est pas une disparition. Les absences dans les étiquettes de trames complètes fournies restent supervisées ; cela ne valide pas ces annotations. Les recadrages inutilisables sont rééchantillonnés jusqu'à 32 fois par étape. Cette exclusion évite des cibles incorrectes aux bords des recadrages, mais supprime certains exemples de mouvement rapide ; elle ne démontre pas la précision sur toute l'étendue des mouvements.
